en: A vintage postcard mounted in an album showing the facade of the Kursaal Hotel d'Italia with a balcony and entrance, and printed text advertising the hotel and restaurant. There is also a small portrait medallion of a man with German text indicating he stayed there in 1888–1890. Below on the album page is a separate photograph of a rustic building and telegraph poles in a hilly landscape labeled 'Ruta'. Handwritten notes in French mention Ruta near Portofino on the Italian Riviera.
